q: How much electricity does a stove, gas lighter, cutlery or cookware unit use a year?
title: Kitchenware unit power: stove to cutlery
short: TERI's Rajkot profile puts a typical unit at 247,565 kWh a year for stoves, 116,405 for knives and cutlery, 73,398 for cookers and non-stick, 72,424 for gas lighters and 31,636 for kitchen baskets. Spread over each unit's output, that is about 0.26 to 0.52 kWh a piece.
audience: Rajkot kitchenware makers asked for a per-piece figure, and buyers checking the one they receive

ul: Stove: 10 units averaging 4.8 lakh pieces; 247,565 kWh, about 0.52 kWh a stove.
Kitchen basket and others: 55 units averaging 85,000 pieces; 31,636 kWh, about 0.37 kWh a piece.
Gas lighter: 53 units averaging 2.1 lakh pieces; 72,424 kWh, about 0.35 kWh a lighter.
Cooker and non-stick cookware: 36 units averaging 2.6 lakh pieces; 73,398 kWh, about 0.29 kWh a piece.
Knife and cutlery: 196 units averaging 4.4 lakh pieces; 116,405 kWh plus 0.144 toe of fuel, about 0.26 kWh a piece.

p: A stove starts as CRC sheet deep drawn on a hydraulic press, is spot welded for the stand, then tested for burner efficiency and flame stability. Presses of 100 to 150 t on 7.5 to 15 hp pumps, and 5 to 10 kVA welders, draw far more per piece than a mechanical press stamping a spoon. Non-stick pans add an electric oven at 400 to 450 C for about 30 minutes per cycle.

ul: Chrome plating on stoves and kitchen baskets is usually sent out. Ask the plater for its power per batch, or list it as outsourced.
Piezo units for gas lighters are imported; their footprint sits with the maker.
The steel, aluminium and plastic, which normally outweigh the factory power.

ol: kWh per piece for the product they buy, not the plant average. If lines share a meter, split by machine hours and say so.
Grams of each material per piece, and what was outsourced.

example.title: CO2 per piece from factory power (estimate)
lines: Cooker or non-stick pan: 0.29 kWh x 0.675 = 0.19 kg
Knife or cutlery piece: 0.26 kWh x 0.675 = 0.18 kg
example.note: Unit kWh, unit counts and output from TERI's Rajkot kitchenware profile; pieces per unit are category output divided by units, so a unit making heavier items will sit higher. Grid factor CEA FY 2025-26.

senseible: Senseible keeps each month's electricity bill behind the kWh you report, in a Scope 3 supplier trail the buyer can open and check, so a per-piece figure rests on bills rather than a spreadsheet.
